A good result could bring income. Recognition of your work may lead to higher pay or a financial reward today. If you're waiting for a deal's outcome, favourable news is worth hoping for. Use the payment for things you've needed rather than to show off your success with an expensive purchase.

Giving up money you need to keep could leave you with a loss today. More demands may wear down your ability to refuse and leave you with higher costs than expected. Doubting your judgement could also let financial terms turn against you. It's fine not to answer on the spot about an amount you can't comfortably manage.

It's a good day to protect your share and prevent a financial loss. Even if someone tries to lower the amount, evidence you've prepared could help you get a fair price. There's no need to give way easily on a deal already being discussed on favourable terms. Calmly check the original agreed amount instead of being swayed by other people's words.

Conflicting messages or a delayed payment could complicate an exchange of money. Different instructions may make it easy to pay twice or misunderstand the amount today. The more you rush, the larger a small mistake could become. If you've already sent money, check with the recipient before sending it again.

Welcome financial news could arrive quickly. An awaited payment may come through or a transaction could finish sooner than expected today. Money arriving when needed may ease worry about urgent expenses too. If you hear about several money matters at once, take care not to mix up amounts or payment destinations.

A money matter that's kept you worried may not end easily. Rejecting every offer for fear of another loss could make you miss a way to reduce costs today. Accepting any terms out of exhaustion, on the other hand, may leave the same burden in place. Start by discussing the amount that can actually be changed instead of trying to finish everything at once.

Past experience could help protect your money today. Recognising unfavourable terms you've seen before may let you avoid the same loss. Leaving the money you've built up where it is instead of moving it hastily could keep some available when needed. Calmly finish familiar transactions before considering an unfamiliar offer.

You could end up carrying an unmanageable financial burden alone today. Several promised payments coming due at once may leave you unable to cover immediate needs. Another promise to repay may not solve the shortage. Say in advance what you can't pay now and make fewer new commitments.

Even with earnings, many costs to cover may keep money from feeling plentiful. More work could bring both income and necessary expenses today. Paying someone else's share too may leave little for you. The larger the sums involved, the more carefully you should calculate your own share separately.

Spending on an unconfirmed rumour could lead to regret. Plenty of talk about earnings may still leave the actual payment undecided today. If preparations keep changing, purchased items and money spent could feel wasted too. Don't spend a large sum first before a specific agreement exists.

You could hear about a new source of income today. Something that interests you may come with an offer of pay, or you could find a chance to start for a small amount. Even without confirmed income yet, there may be something worth looking into. When welcome news arrives, ask how much the preparations would cost too.

A hastily begun transaction could stop halfway and leave a loss. If plans change after you've paid the necessary costs, getting money back may become troublesome today. Be careful about adding a large sum just because things feel promising. The more an offer urges you to join quickly, the more you should check the refund terms first.

A quickly progressing transaction could bring income today. An item you've put up for sale or work that needs a fast finish may result in payment. Faster progress could also mean higher travel or preparation costs. Look at what remains after expenses as well as what you'll be paid.

Spending to keep up with others could lead to regret today. You may want to stand out through an impressive item or a large gift. If spending grows while income stays the same, there could be less for living costs. Spend on what you need now rather than what others have.

A good impression and trust could bring a financial opportunity. Someone who's noticed your abilities may offer work or help with a deal today. Income from something you've enjoyed could make earning feel especially rewarding. Generosity doesn't require reducing agreed pay before anyone asks.

Insisting on your preferred amount could cost you a decent deal. Standards set too high may put an attainable profit out of reach today. Pressuring people to do more could also increase costs. Before promising a large income, recalculate what would remain under the current terms.

Something you've led could bring money today. If you've taken responsibility for a deal, you may receive pay or profit that reflects your work. Even if you're offered something larger, drawing on your experience could help you choose what's worthwhile. Be confident about what you agree to do, while keeping costs within what you can actually afford.

overall.cups.01.reversed.headline: Something you've looked forward to may feel less enjoyable than expected.
flow: An anticipated pleasure could leave you disappointed today. A gathering you expected to enjoy may feel awkward, or a cheerful remark could receive a blunt reply. When your feelings don't come across, even a small incident may hurt.
Don't assume the worst about someone just because they don't respond straight away. You also don't have to cheerfully accept plans you don't want.
overall.cups.01.reversed.do: If someone suggests plans you don't want, be honest about how you feel. You don't have to pretend you're pleased and agree just to keep them happy.
overall.cups.01.reversed.pause: Don't assume bad intentions because a cheerful remark gets little response. A blunt reply alone can't tell you everything the other person feels.

overall.cups.01.upright.headline: Something you enjoy could make the day a happy one.
flow: Small things could bring you pleasure today. A welcome message may arrive, or you might find something you like somewhere you stop by chance. Someone you've just met could also show unexpected kindness.
Accept an invitation that appeals to you. Saying thank you can make it easier to talk comfortably next time.
overall.cups.01.upright.do: If an invitation appeals to you, let the person know you'd like to go. You can thank them for inviting you at the same time.
overall.cups.01.upright.pause: Don't overlook a kindness from someone you've just met. Even a brief thank-you can make your next conversation more comfortable.

overall.cups.02.reversed.headline: Different expectations could disrupt even a simple agreement.
flow: You may disagree with someone you thought you understood well today. A casual request could mean different things to each of you, or one person may feel they're making most of the concessions. Something meant to be easier together could become more complicated than doing it alone.
Explain the part you've assumed the other person already knows. Expressing hurt through sarcasm could obscure the original request as well.
overall.cups.02.reversed.do: If someone understood your request differently, explain it again. Be specific about what you'd like them to do and how.
overall.cups.02.reversed.pause: Even if you feel you've made all the concessions over a request, don't express your hurt through sarcasm. It can make what you actually want harder to understand.

overall.cups.02.upright.headline: Mutual understanding could help even a difficult request go well.
flow: Other people could make things easier for you today. A request for help may be warmly received, or you could solve something together that would be difficult alone. Conversation with someone you've felt awkward around may be easier than expected.
Return the favour in a way you can manage. Being honest about what you both want can make it easier to keep working together without pressure.
overall.cups.02.upright.do: If someone has helped you, show your thanks by offering help you can give in return. Ask what they need and do what you can manage.
overall.cups.02.upright.pause: Don't expect someone to know what help you need just because you understand each other well. Say clearly what you're hoping for.

overall.cups.03.reversed.headline: A gathering you expected to enjoy could become a headache.
flow: Spending time with others could prove more troublesome than expected today. A light joke may turn into gossip, or trying to please everyone could lead you somewhere you don't want to be. Getting carried away could mean saying something you regret once you're home.
If an uncomfortable conversation starts, you don't have to add anything. It's fine to leave at the time you'd originally planned.
overall.cups.03.reversed.do: If a gathering keeps going but you don't want to stay, it's fine to leave when you planned. You don't need to stay until the end just to keep everyone happy.
overall.cups.03.reversed.pause: Don't add to unkind talk about someone just because everyone is laughing. An offhand joke could later be repeated as gossip.

overall.cups.03.upright.headline: There could be good news to share and a reason to celebrate.
flow: Happy news or plenty of shared laughter could brighten the day. Something several people have worked on may end well, and you could get a chance to meet people you're pleased to see. Others may include you in something enjoyable you'd have missed alone.
Send your congratulations, even if it's only a short message. Remembering everyone who joined the gathering can make the day enjoyable for all.
overall.cups.03.upright.do: If someone has something to celebrate, let them know you were pleased to hear the news, even if you only say a few words.
overall.cups.03.upright.pause: At a gathering to celebrate, don't speak badly of someone else in an effort to liven things up.

overall.cups.04.reversed.headline: An opportunity you overlooked could prove useful now.
flow: Fresh news could arrive about something that's been frustratingly quiet. An offer that didn't interest you before may fit now, or trying something without high expectations could be surprisingly enjoyable. A new option might also help with a long-standing dilemma.
Look again at a message or notice you previously passed over. There's no need to judge it exactly as you did before just because it didn't appeal then.
overall.cups.04.reversed.do: If fresh news arrives about a long-standing dilemma, look into it. Check for an approach or option you hadn't considered before.
overall.cups.04.reversed.pause: Don't immediately refuse an offer again just because you disliked it before. It may fit your circumstances better now.

overall.cups.04.upright.headline: Things may be uneventful without feeling very satisfying.
flow: A day that goes reasonably well could still leave you wanting more. The news you're waiting for may not arrive, while other offers seem uninteresting. Something you dismiss as insignificant could be a source of regret later.
Take one look at the details even if an offer doesn't immediately appeal. Waiting for one thing doesn't mean you need to refuse everything else.
overall.cups.04.upright.do: Look at the details of a new offer even if it seems uninteresting. Dismissing it on first impressions could leave you regretting it later.
overall.cups.04.upright.pause: Don't turn down every new offer simply because the news you're waiting for hasn't arrived yet.

overall.cups.05.reversed.headline: You could put things right after a setback and carry on.
flow: Something that went wrong once could be easier to sort out today. You may be able to talk with someone you're hurt by, or find different support for something you've given up on. A matter stalled by a previous result could gradually get going again.
Hear out someone who reaches out first. Repeatedly bringing up old mistakes could cost you a chance to start again.
overall.cups.05.reversed.do: If someone offers help with something you gave up on, hear them out. Look together at where that help would let you pick things up again.
overall.cups.05.reversed.pause: If you're talking again with someone who hurt your feelings, don't keep arguing only about past mistakes. You could miss the chance to discuss what needs putting right.

overall.cups.05.upright.headline: Something you've hoped for could fall through.
flow: Not getting the result you expected may leave you disappointed today. Something you've been waiting for could be cancelled, or help you were counting on may not come. One setback might make it hard to notice other good news.
Separate what's still possible from what's already over. Responding coldly to someone who's trying to help could put the remaining support out of reach too.
overall.cups.05.upright.do: If something you hoped for has gone wrong, keep listening for other news. Focusing only on the disappointment could make you miss help that's still available.
overall.cups.05.upright.pause: When things go wrong, don't take your frustration out on someone who's trying to help. A cold response could cost you support you could still receive.

overall.cups.06.reversed.headline: Moving beyond an old approach could bring a better result.
flow: Something that didn't work before could turn out differently today. Changed circumstances may make it easier than expected, or someone new could help more than an old contact. A choice based only on fond memories may not live up to them.
Check the current conditions before trying again. You don't need to dismiss a new offer solely because of what happened in the past.
overall.cups.06.reversed.do: Before retrying something that didn't work out before, check the current conditions. See whether the difficulties you faced last time have changed.
overall.cups.06.reversed.pause: Don't assume a past success means the same result this time. The circumstances may be different now.

overall.cups.06.upright.headline: An old connection could bring welcome, dependable help.
flow: Good things may come through familiar people or places today. Hearing from someone after a long time could be a pleasure, and an established connection may provide help you need. An earlier experience could also be useful in solving something that's stuck.
If someone comes to mind, send a friendly greeting. Catching up on how you've both been before asking for help can make the conversation more comfortable.
overall.cups.06.upright.do: If an old acquaintance comes to mind, get in touch to say hello. You can catch up on what you've both been doing.
overall.cups.06.upright.pause: Don't open with nothing but requests when contacting someone after a long time. Catching up first can make it easier to discuss what you need.

overall.cups.07.reversed.headline: Clearer information could help you reach a decision.
flow: Several uncertain possibilities could begin to sort themselves out today. Confusing terms may become clear, making it easier to rule out offers that don't suit you. It's a good day to find a practical answer to something you've considered for a long time.
Once you've chosen, make the necessary contact. Looking for more offers when the confirmed conditions haven't changed could simply delay the start.
overall.cups.07.reversed.do: If you've chosen the offer that suits you, tell the person you'd like to take part instead of keeping the decision to yourself.
overall.cups.07.reversed.pause: Don't keep searching for new offers after checking the terms and making your choice. If nothing has changed, more comparisons could simply delay your start.

overall.cups.07.upright.headline: Appealing opportunities may offer less than they seem.
flow: Several attractive offers could make it hard to choose one with real value today. Impressive terms may leave something out, or what you can actually receive may differ from your hopes. Taking everything at once for fear of missing out could lead to regret.
Start with facts you can check now when comparing offers. Don't commit on the strength of every appealing detail that hasn't yet been settled.
overall.cups.07.upright.do: When comparing offers, check what you can actually receive. Keep unsettled details separate from confirmed terms.
overall.cups.07.upright.pause: Don't accept every tempting offer at once for fear of missing out. They may look good without delivering as much as you expect.

overall.cups.08.reversed.headline: Hesitating over whether to leave could prolong the same discomfort.
flow: A problem you thought was over could return today. You may keep accepting something you dislike, or a decision to change things could be postponed again. Staying because it's familiar may leave the frustration unchanged.
If you want to try a little longer, say clearly what needs to change. If you agree to do it again without any conditions, the other person may see no reason to change.
overall.cups.08.reversed.do: If you want to keep trying something that's been uncomfortable, tell the other person what needs to change so the same problem doesn't recur.
overall.cups.08.reversed.pause: Don't keep accepting something you want to stop simply because it's familiar. You could face the same discomfort again.

overall.cups.08.upright.headline: Leaving something behind could reveal another opportunity.
flow: Something you've worked at for a long time may have little more to offer today. A long-awaited result could be unsatisfying, or continuing may no longer be as enjoyable as it was. Bringing it to an end could let you consider another opportunity you've postponed.
If there's no reason to continue, honour the remaining commitments and finish. Time already spent isn't a reason to take on more of something you don't want.
overall.cups.08.upright.do: If you have no reason to continue something, keep the commitments you've already made, then bring it to an end.
overall.cups.08.upright.pause: Don't take on more of something you don't want just because the time you've spent feels too precious to waste. Consider whether you have a reason to keep doing it from now on.

overall.cups.09.reversed.headline: Getting what you wanted may not feel as satisfying as expected.
flow: Even if things go well, one part of the outcome could disappoint you today. The result you wanted may not fit your circumstances, or something you expected to enjoy could prove inconvenient. You don't have to love it just because others envy it.
Consider both the benefits and the difficulties of what you've received. Taking on unnecessary new things to make up for disappointment may only add to the burden.
overall.cups.09.reversed.do: If you've got the result you wanted but still feel disappointed, look for anything that's actually inconvenient or more trouble than you expected.
overall.cups.09.reversed.pause: Don't start lots of new things because a result feels disappointing. What you start to soothe that disappointment could simply leave you with more to handle.

overall.cups.09.upright.headline: A wish could come true and leave you feeling satisfied.
flow: The result you want could make this an enjoyable day. A long-awaited opportunity may arrive, or something you've waited on could be decided in your favour. There may be something to feel proud of even without telling everyone about it.
Give yourself time to enjoy a good result. You don't have to rush into the next thing because you feel you should achieve something bigger immediately.
overall.cups.09.upright.do: If something you've waited for has gone your way, celebrate it by taking a moment to think about what makes you happiest about the result.
overall.cups.09.upright.pause: Don't rush into the next thing to achieve even more as soon as you get a good result. It's fine to give yourself time to be satisfied with what you've done.

overall.cups.10.reversed.headline: Something small could cause tension with someone close.
flow: Different expectations may hurt even in a comfortable relationship today. Complaints could arise about something you thought would be fun together, or someone who's always said things were fine may speak up unexpectedly. A quiet atmosphere doesn't necessarily mean everyone is satisfied.
Ask what each person wants when making plans together. Deciding first and announcing it because you're close could turn a small hurt into a bigger one.
overall.cups.10.reversed.do: When making a shared decision, ask what the other person wants even if you're close. Someone who usually agrees may think differently this time.
overall.cups.10.reversed.pause: Don't assume everyone is happy with a choice just because no one complains. People can have different expectations even when they say little.

overall.cups.10.upright.headline: A comfortable, enjoyable day with people close to you is possible.
flow: Relations with people around you could be warm, and shared plans may go smoothly today. You might celebrate someone's good news or receive help after sharing a worry you've kept to yourself. A familiar setting could give you a welcome sense of belonging and reassurance.
Make a little time for the people you usually see. A meal together or a simple check-in could bring a pleasant conversation without elaborate plans.
overall.cups.10.upright.do: Make time to catch up with someone close to you. You can talk over a meal without making elaborate plans.
overall.cups.10.upright.pause: Don't give a half-hearted response when someone you often spend time with shares good news. Say you're pleased for them, even though you know each other well.

overall.cups.11.reversed.headline: A casual remark could be misunderstood.
flow: Even a well-meant comment may come across wrongly today. An answer you're hoping for might not arrive, or a playful remark could hurt someone's feelings. Trying to test their reaction may keep you from saying what you actually mean.
Make a request or apology directly rather than mixing it with a joke. Sending a sulky message because a reply is late could make things harder to resolve.
overall.cups.11.reversed.do: If you need to ask a favour or apologise, make your sincerity clear. Hinting through jokes could make it sound as though you don't mean it seriously.
overall.cups.11.reversed.pause: Don't make a sulky remark because an answer you're hoping for is late. Trying to test the other person's reaction could give them the wrong idea about what you mean.

overall.cups.11.upright.headline: An unexpected friendly message could brighten your day.
flow: A small suggestion or a greeting could be the start of something good today. Someone unexpected may approach you, or a casual attempt could receive a warm response. People may be welcoming even if you're new and a little awkward.
If there's something you'd like to try, suggest doing it together. If the other person is interested too, you can discuss it in more detail.
overall.cups.11.upright.do: If there's something you'd like to do together, suggest it casually. If the other person is interested too, you can discuss when and how to try it.
overall.cups.11.upright.pause: Don't put off saying hello because you think you'll be awkward the first time. Someone may respond warmly even if you haven't prepared the perfect words.

overall.cups.12.reversed.headline: Warm words may not lead to a promise being kept.
flow: A welcome offer may fail to turn into anything today. Someone who promised to help could change their mind, or plans you thought were settled may fade away. The more you pin your hopes on it, the more disappointing it could feel.
Ask specifically what the person can do and when. You don't need to give up every other opportunity before getting a definite answer.
overall.cups.12.reversed.do: If someone promises they'll do something for you, ask exactly what they can do and when. Distinguish encouraging words from definite arrangements.
overall.cups.12.reversed.pause: If someone hasn't clearly said what they'll do and when, don't give up all your other opportunities for that promise.

overall.cups.12.upright.headline: A kind offer could arrive and a request may be warmly received.
flow: Someone's sincere approach could help things work out today. A welcome invitation may arrive, or someone might offer help before you've asked. Even a request you raise cautiously could get a kind answer.
Be clear about your interest in an invitation. Expressing your appreciation can help the other person see what else they could do for you.
overall.cups.12.upright.do: If you need to ask for help, gently explain what you need. You can begin with the part that's difficult to manage alone.
overall.cups.12.upright.pause: If you like an invitation, don't give a vague reply that makes you sound uninterested. Letting the person know whether you'd like to join makes it easier for them to arrange it.

overall.cups.13.reversed.headline: Looking after other people could delay your own tasks.
flow: Doing someone a kindness may still leave you feeling uncomfortable today. Agreeing to too many favours could stop you finishing your own tasks, and a lack of thanks may leave you hurt. It's difficult to keep everyone happy.
Say how much help you can offer at the start. If a request already feels like too much, it's fine to say so then instead of smiling through it and struggling later.
overall.cups.13.reversed.do: If someone asks for help, leave time to finish your own tasks and tell them at the start how much you can do.
overall.cups.13.reversed.pause: Don't smile and accept an already burdensome request just to keep the other person happy. Even if refusing is difficult, say what would be hard for you then and there.

overall.cups.13.upright.headline: Someone who understands your circumstances could ease a worry.
flow: Kind help may be available even if things are difficult today. Someone could notice what you need before you've fully explained, or talking about an upsetting experience may bring a better response than expected. A conversation that's been hard to have could become more comfortable.
Gently raise a worry you've been keeping to yourself with someone you feel at ease with. Explaining your situation doesn't mean asking them to solve all of it.
overall.cups.13.upright.do: If you've been worrying about something alone, tell someone you trust what's happening. You can start with what upset you.
overall.cups.13.upright.pause: Don't ask someone to solve the whole problem just because you've opened up to them. You can ask for help with just the part that's hard to handle alone.

overall.cups.14.reversed.headline: Someone's mood could cause a decision to be reversed.
flow: An answer you've already received could change easily and cause difficulty today. Someone who agreed to help might withdraw because they're upset, or an important discussion could turn into an emotional argument. Trying to accommodate every mood may lead to more demands.
Keep the person's feelings separate from what was actually agreed when you talk. Don't suddenly abandon something you've taken on just because you're angry either.
overall.cups.14.reversed.do: If someone changes an agreement because they're upset, remind them what was originally agreed. Discuss why they're hurt separately from whether they can keep the agreement.
overall.cups.14.reversed.pause: Don't suddenly abandon something you've taken on or go back on a promise simply because you're angry.

overall.cups.14.upright.headline: Even a difficult matter could be settled calmly.
flow: Something that's caused hurt feelings could be resolved without a major argument today. A person who understands the circumstances may help mediate, or a difficult request could receive a practical answer. Even without agreement at first, you have a good chance of reaching a conclusion both sides accept.
Be specific about the help you want when discussing the problem. Find out what's difficult for everyone rather than hearing only one side.
overall.cups.14.upright.do: When asking for help with a difficult problem, be specific about what you'd like the person to do. Knowing what you need makes it easier for them to find a way to help.
overall.cups.14.upright.pause: In a disagreement, don't take sides based on the first account you hear. Listen to what each person is finding difficult.

overall.major.chariot.reversed.headline: Rushing could leave you with more problems to sort out.
flow: Things may not go the way you'd hoped today. A task you meant to finish quickly could run into trouble, and taking on several at once may make you miss a deadline. Pushing harder won't necessarily get you further today.
If progress has stopped, find out what's holding things up. Starting something else before solving the first problem could leave you with even more to sort out.
overall.major.chariot.reversed.do: If something you're working on has stopped progressing, find out where it's stuck before rushing to push ahead again.
overall.major.chariot.reversed.pause: Don't try to make up for falling behind by starting more things. Juggling them could also make you miss the deadline you agreed to.

overall.major.chariot.upright.headline: Things are likely to go your way today.
flow: Something you've been worrying about could be resolved, and the news you've been waiting for may be good. An attempt that failed once could be worth another try. Something you refused to give up on may finally pay off.
Finishing what you've started will make the next task easier. Tackle unfinished business before starting several new things.
overall.major.chariot.upright.do: If you've put something off since an earlier attempt failed, give it another try. Start by looking at the part that held you up last time.
overall.major.chariot.upright.pause: Even if something new catches your interest, don't abandon what you're doing to start it if you can finish the current task first.

overall.major.death.reversed.headline: Putting off an ending could bring the same problem back.
flow: An old problem could hold you up again today. Something you've hoped would change may remain the same, and a request you thought was settled could return. Sticking only to familiar methods may keep things frustrating.
Be clear when you don't intend to continue something. Leaving the possibility open out of guilt may stop the other person realising it's over.
overall.major.death.reversed.do: If you don't intend to continue something, say clearly that you're stopping. Avoid leaving the impression that you might do it later.
overall.major.death.reversed.pause: If the same problem keeps recurring, don't insist on using the same method simply because it's familiar.

overall.major.death.upright.headline: A long-running matter could end and leave room for something else.
flow: Something you've been holding on to for a while could come to an end today. Even if the outcome is disappointing, you may no longer have to wait or keep trying. Another opportunity could take its place, or you may be free to start something you've postponed.
Once a matter is over, say any goodbyes and finish tidying up. It's time to see what's now possible instead of trying to restore things to how they were.
overall.major.death.upright.do: If something you've been involved in for a long time has ended, say any goodbyes you still need to and tie up the remaining loose ends.
overall.major.death.upright.pause: Even if you're disappointed by how a long effort ended, don't keep clinging to something that's over in an attempt to make it the way it was.

overall.major.devil.reversed.headline: You could get a chance to leave a burdensome situation.
flow: It's a good day to step away from something you've wanted to stop. You may stop doing a favour you've found hard to refuse, or a situation where you've felt pushed around could end. Getting back what's rightfully yours may carry fewer consequences than you feared.
Say briefly and clearly that you won't keep taking it on. Agreeing to help again out of guilt after stopping could bring the same burden back.
overall.major.devil.reversed.do: If you no longer want to do a favour that's become a burden, say no clearly instead of giving a long, indirect explanation.
overall.major.devil.reversed.pause: Don't do the same favour again out of guilt after deciding to stop. Helping once more could leave you doing it repeatedly.

overall.major.devil.upright.headline: Giving in to temptation could leave you with a burden.
flow: Something that feels enjoyable today could cause trouble later. An offer may be hard to refuse, or you could be drawn back into something you've been trying to stop. What looks like an easy benefit may come with substantial demands.

The more appealing the offer, the more useful it is to hear what's expected of you first. If it's something you've wanted to leave behind, you can keep your distance even when asked for just one more time.
overall.major.devil.upright.do: If an offer is tempting, ask what you'd have to do in return as well as what you'd gain. The demands could be large compared with the benefit.
overall.major.devil.upright.pause: Don't agree to do something you've wanted to stop just because you're asked for one more time. Even if saying no feels difficult now, consider what you'd be left having to do later.

overall.major.emperor.reversed.headline: A one-sided decision could hold things up.
flow: Rigid demands or stubbornness may delay things today. Someone could try to change an agreement, or you may wait a long time because one person controls every decision. Trying to force progress could make cooperation even harder.
Check both the original agreement and the reason for changing it. If you're making the decision, listen to what the others are dealing with before deciding.
overall.major.emperor.reversed.do: If someone wants to change an agreement, ask what's changed in their circumstances. Compare that with the original agreement to see whether a change is needed.
overall.major.emperor.reversed.pause: Don't disregard other people's circumstances just because the decision is yours. Listening to the people involved can make it easier to get their cooperation.

overall.major.emperor.upright.headline: Reliable support could help things run smoothly.
flow: Plans have a good chance of going ahead without major disruption today. Someone experienced may help you make a decision that's difficult to reach alone. Getting the permission or support you need could finally let you move ahead.
Discuss a request you can't manage alone with someone you trust. If someone has already agreed to help, you don't have to take all the work back.
overall.major.emperor.upright.do: If a request feels too much to handle, discuss it with someone who's dealt with something similar. Explain which parts are difficult to decide on alone.
overall.major.emperor.upright.pause: If someone has already agreed to help, don't take back everything you've left them to do and try to handle it all yourself.

overall.major.empress.reversed.headline: The results may feel small compared with the effort you've put in.
flow: A task you've cared about may not produce as much as you'd hoped today. Looking after other people's work could delay your own, without bringing the thanks you'd expect for your effort. Doing more won't necessarily improve things.
If you've already helped enough, leave the other person to finish their part. You don't need to postpone your own work to keep doing theirs.
overall.major.empress.reversed.do: If you've helped someone enough and your own work is falling behind, finish yours first. You can leave them to complete the rest of theirs.
overall.major.empress.reversed.pause: Don't do even more for someone because they haven't thanked you. Extra effort may still not bring the response you're hoping for.

overall.major.empress.upright.headline: Care and effort could bring satisfying results and support.
flow: Something you've put care into for a long time could bring a satisfying result today. Help may arrive for something you've struggled with alone, and people around you could be generous with their care. Steady effort is likely to be more rewarding than something hastily started.
Share a good result with the people involved. Thank anyone who's helped, and let them know you can return the favour another time.
overall.major.empress.upright.do: If a shared effort has gone well, let the people who helped know the good news. Share the celebration and thank them for their part.
overall.major.empress.upright.pause: Don't assume people owe you help just because they've been supportive. Consider the time and effort it takes them to help.

overall.major.fool.reversed.headline: Starting unprepared could mean doing the job twice.
flow: Something you've taken lightly could be a source of mistakes today. You might leave without something you need or get into difficulty over a commitment you haven't properly checked. Relying on luck is less likely to work than usual.
If you're going somewhere for the first time, check the opening hours and what to bring. A quick errand could take longer than expected, so leave space before your next appointment.
overall.major.fool.reversed.do: Before going somewhere for the first time, check the opening hours and what you need to bring. Setting off unprepared could mean a wasted trip.
overall.major.fool.reversed.pause: Even if you expect something to be quick, don't arrange your next appointment straight after it. It could take longer and make you late for that appointment.

overall.major.fool.upright.headline: A new beginning could bring a welcome opportunity.
flow: Trying something for the first time could bring unexpected enjoyment or a useful opportunity today. Going somewhere unfamiliar may lead to helpful information or a good connection. Something you've spent a long time considering is worth a small first try.
If you're interested in an activity, start with a one-day trial. You don't need to commit to going regularly before you've tried it.
overall.major.fool.upright.do: If you've been considering an activity, try it for a day. Firsthand experience can make it easier to decide whether it suits you.
overall.major.fool.upright.pause: Don't commit to an activity long term before you've tried it. Give it at least a day before deciding whether to keep going.

overall.major.hanged_man.reversed.headline: Waiting without a clear end could waste the day.
flow: Things may stay where they are without rewarding your patience today. Holding on for an answer that isn't coming could make you miss another opportunity. If you're the only one who keeps giving way, the same burden may fall on you again.
Ask clearly when you can expect an answer. You don't need to promise to keep waiting without an agreed end point.
overall.major.hanged_man.reversed.do: If you've had no answer, ask the other person clearly when they can reply instead of simply continuing to wait.
overall.major.hanged_man.reversed.pause: If you've been the only one making concessions, don't promise to keep waiting unconditionally again. You could end up carrying the same burden.

overall.major.hanged_man.upright.headline: Waiting may take longer, but rushing is unlikely to help.
flow: The result you want is unlikely to arrive immediately today. An answer may be delayed, and progress could feel slow compared with your effort. During the pause, you may notice circumstances you've missed and find another approach.
Hear the other person's reasons instead of insisting on a conclusion straight away. If it doesn't have to be finished today, giving it more time could bring a better answer.
overall.major.hanged_man.upright.do: If an answer is taking longer than expected, hear the other person's reasons. Understanding circumstances you've missed may help you think of another approach.
overall.major.hanged_man.upright.pause: If something doesn't have to be finished today, don't press for an immediate decision. Giving it more time could bring a better answer.

overall.major.hermit.reversed.headline: A problem you're handling alone could stay stuck longer.
flow: Lack of the help you need may slow things down today. A problem kept to yourself could go round in circles, while putting off contact may mean hearing important news late. Simply waiting won't let anyone else know what's going on.
Explain what you need instead of assuming that speaking up won't help. Checking in or asking for help could restart a conversation that's gone quiet.
overall.major.hermit.reversed.do: If you haven't been able to solve something alone, explain exactly what help you need. You can describe what you've tried and what remains to be done.
overall.major.hermit.reversed.pause: Don't assume asking for help is pointless just because you haven't heard from someone in a while. If you haven't told them, they may not know what's going on.

overall.major.hermit.upright.headline: A quiet look at a problem could reveal a long-awaited answer.
flow: It's a good day to solve something you've thought about for a long time. An answer you couldn't find by asking around may appear when you examine it slowly on your own. Quick updates or major lucky breaks may be scarce, but one difficult issue could become clear.
Have an important conversation somewhere quiet instead of in front of a crowd. One piece of advice you really need may help more than adding lots of comments.
overall.major.hermit.upright.do: If you need advice on something you've been thinking about for a long time, talk it over somewhere quiet. It can be easier to ask your questions calmly away from a group.
overall.major.hermit.upright.pause: Don't try to follow every opinion you hear just because you want a quick answer. Pick out the advice relevant to your problem and consider that first.

overall.major.hierophant.reversed.headline: A different approach could work where the usual one fails.
flow: Your usual way of doing things may not work well today. An old rule might no longer fit the situation, or advice that suits others could be difficult in your circumstances. A change of method may lead to a surprisingly simple solution.
When someone recommends something, explain why it would be difficult for you. Following along just because everyone else does it could leave you struggling with something that doesn't fit.
overall.major.hierophant.reversed.do: If a suggested approach doesn't fit your circumstances, explain what makes it difficult. Discuss another way instead of assuming you have to follow it exactly.
overall.major.hierophant.reversed.pause: Don't stick with an approach that isn't working just because it's how you've always done things. Check whether it still fits the situation.

overall.major.hierophant.upright.headline: Advice from someone experienced could solve a stubborn problem.
flow: A reliable answer to something you've been worrying over alone could arrive today. Someone who's been through it before may explain the necessary steps or point out something you've missed. Agreements made by a group also have a good chance of being kept.
If you're facing something unfamiliar, read the official guidance and listen to someone with experience. Following a method that has worked before can spare you unnecessary trial and error.
overall.major.hierophant.upright.do: Before tackling something unfamiliar, read the guidance and ask someone experienced about anything unclear. They may point out details that are easy to miss.
overall.major.hierophant.upright.pause: Don't skip required steps just because they seem inconvenient. Following a proven order can reduce the chance of having to do things again.

overall.major.high_priestess.reversed.headline: Something you think you know could lead to a mistake.
flow: Information you thought was correct may turn out to be wrong and disrupt your plans today. It's easy to miss an important explanation or judge a situation by its most obvious cause. Stepping in before you understand the circumstances could mean offering the wrong kind of help.
Ask again about any part you couldn't confidently explain. Separating what you've heard from what you've assumed can prevent unnecessary misunderstandings.
overall.major.high_priestess.reversed.do: Before helping someone, ask enough to understand their situation. Acting on a rough guess could mean offering the wrong kind of help.
overall.major.high_priestess.reversed.pause: Don't mix your own assumptions into an account of what you've heard. Saying when you don't know something for sure can reduce misunderstandings.

overall.major.high_priestess.upright.headline: An answer may take time, but an important clue could emerge.
flow: The answer you want may be slow to arrive today. Important information is still missing, so deciding immediately could mean overlooking something. A matter you've been examining carefully may yield a clue that helps solve the problem.
Listen to the whole explanation and ask about anything you don't understand. Acting as though you already know the answer could make you miss what you need to hear.
overall.major.high_priestess.upright.do: After hearing the full explanation, ask about anything you still don't understand. That part may hold a clue to solving the problem.
overall.major.high_priestess.upright.pause: Don't rush a decision based only on what you know because the answer you want is taking time. Important information may still be missing.

overall.major.judgement.reversed.headline: Delaying a decision could cost you a second chance.
flow: Hesitation may make you late even for something you could do well today. A past result could hold you back from answering, or magnifying your own shortcomings might make you pass up an opening. Trying to win everyone's approval will make deciding harder.
First, find out when an answer is needed. Focus on what needs correcting from the previous mistake, then consider this opportunity on its own.
overall.major.judgement.reversed.do: If you owe someone an answer, check when you need to decide. Don't let the deadline pass while you wait to feel certain.
overall.major.judgement.reversed.pause: Don't delay a decision in an effort to win everyone's approval. Trying to follow everyone's advice could make you miss a chance to do something you're good at.

overall.major.judgement.upright.headline: A second chance could bring a better result.
flow: Another attempt at something you've missed out on could become possible today. You may hear about a matter that's gone quiet or receive belated recognition for past effort. Showing what's changed since then could get a better response.
Before trying again, correct whatever held you back last time. It's also a good day to give a clear answer you've long postponed.
overall.major.judgement.upright.do: If you get another chance, correct what went wrong last time as you prepare so you don't repeat the same mistake.
overall.major.judgement.upright.pause: If you've decided whether to accept an offer you've long left unanswered, make your answer clear instead of putting it off again.

overall.major.justice.reversed.headline: You could face unfair criticism despite doing things properly.
flow: Not getting recognition for your efforts could be upsetting today. A comment from someone who doesn't know the circumstances may cause a misunderstanding, or you could be judged by a different standard from the one agreed. Arguing without evidence may obscure important facts.
Calmly correct anything that's been passed on wrongly. Adding claims you can't check because you're hurt could undermine trust in what you say.
overall.major.justice.reversed.do: If an inaccurate account has led to a misunderstanding about you, calmly point out and explain the parts that aren't true.
overall.major.justice.reversed.pause: Don't add claims you're unsure of when responding to unfair treatment. People could then doubt even the truthful parts of what you say.

overall.major.justice.upright.headline: A fair result could reflect the effort you've made.
flow: An unfair situation could be put right, giving you a chance to receive your fair share today. Where accounts have differed, checking the facts may lead to a conclusion that makes sense. Keeping your promises faithfully could bring a good result.
For an important conversation, check what's recorded rather than relying on memory. Being open about facts that don't favour you lets you ask the other person to do the same.
overall.major.justice.upright.do: If you remember an agreement differently, look at the record of it together. What you actually agreed matters more than who feels more certain.
overall.major.justice.upright.pause: Don't leave out inconvenient facts when asking for your fair share. Be open about those too if you're asking the other person to tell the whole truth.

overall.major.lovers.reversed.headline: Different wishes could make a decision difficult.
flow: Things may go awry because people want different outcomes today. Even plans you thought were settled could reveal different expectations once you discuss them closely. A choice made on a passing impulse may bring regret later.
Make your own conditions clear before agreeing. Avoiding an awkward conversation now could lead to a bigger argument once things are under way.
overall.major.lovers.reversed.do: If you've agreed to do something together, discuss what each of you expects beforehand. You may understand the same agreement differently.
overall.major.lovers.reversed.pause: Don't accept terms you dislike just to avoid spoiling the mood. Putting off an uncomfortable conversation could lead to a bigger argument later.

overall.major.lovers.upright.headline: Working with someone who wants the same things could go well.
flow: Someone may join you in tackling something you've been considering alone. With your wishes closely matched, making plans could be easy, and it's a good day to choose an option you like. Agreement may come without either of you having to force it.
Before deciding together, say what each of you wants. Choosing something you both understand and accept, instead of terms that merely look good, can mean fewer complaints afterwards.
overall.major.lovers.upright.do: If you're making a decision together, discuss what matters most to each of you before trying to accommodate the other person.
overall.major.lovers.upright.pause: Don't agree to a choice you're uncomfortable with just because the terms look good. Check whether you can accept it so it doesn't trouble you later.

overall.major.magician.reversed.headline: Convincing promises may not produce real results.
flow: Something you've been led to expect could turn out to be disappointing today. A supposedly ready plan may prove poorly prepared once it starts, or an easy-sounding explanation may leave out important conditions. Deciding on appearances alone could be difficult to undo.
When an offer comes in, check what's actually been done and what preparation is still needed. Don't promise you can do something you're not yet able to deliver yourself.
overall.major.magician.reversed.do: If someone proposes something they say will be easy, ask what they've already prepared. Check whether their explanation leaves out any conditions.
overall.major.magician.reversed.pause: Don't promise you can do something you haven't learned to do just to reassure someone. Be clear about what you can actually offer.

overall.major.magician.upright.headline: Putting your preparation to use could bring results.
flow: A chance to use what you've prepared may come along today. It's a good time to start a plan you've only thought about, or use a skill to solve a stubborn problem. Doing something in practice could get a better response than simply explaining it.
Try a method you've learned where it's needed. It's fine to begin with what you already know instead of putting it off to learn more.
overall.major.magician.upright.do: If you're stuck on a problem, choose a method you've already learned that could help with it, and give it a try.
overall.major.magician.upright.pause: Don't put off something you've prepared for just because there's more to learn. First see whether you can start with what you already know.

overall.major.moon.reversed.headline: A confusing situation could become clearer and ease your worries.
flow: An explanation may finally arrive for something that's left you puzzled. It's a good day for clearing up needless misunderstandings and correcting a story that's been passed on incorrectly. You may find the situation isn't as bad as you feared.
Adjust your plans to reflect what you've confirmed. Don't assume unanswered questions have been settled as well.
overall.major.moon.reversed.do: If you've learned what was behind a confusing situation, revise your plans to reflect the information you've now confirmed.
overall.major.moon.reversed.pause: Don't assume the answers you're still waiting for will be good just because one misunderstanding has cleared up. Separate what's confirmed from what's still pending.

overall.major.moon.upright.headline: Uncertain information could lead you to the wrong conclusion.
flow: Reliable answers may be hard to get, slowing things down today. Something you were told was fine could change, or it may be unclear whose account is right. A worry could also seem worse than the actual situation.
Base important decisions on what you've checked for yourself. Reacting straight away to something you've heard secondhand could create a misunderstanding or an unnecessary argument.
overall.major.moon.upright.do: Before an important decision, check for yourself whether what you've heard secondhand is true.
overall.major.moon.upright.pause: Don't immediately confront someone over a worrying story you've heard. You may have misunderstood it or taken it to be worse than it is.

overall.major.star.reversed.headline: Delayed news could leave you disappointed.
flow: Things may not improve as much as you'd hoped today. Something you expected to go well could still lack a clear answer, and small progress may seem unimpressive. Don't treat an unfinished matter as a failure.
Check where things stand if they're still in progress. Cutting off contact or refusing help because you're disappointed could make it harder to get going again.
overall.major.star.reversed.do: If news you're waiting for is late, ask how things are progressing. Find out whether a decision is still pending or something has actually become more difficult.
overall.major.star.reversed.pause: Don't cut off needed contact or refuse help because things aren't improving as much as you'd hoped. A conversation ended in disappointment can be hard to restart.

overall.major.star.upright.headline: Encouraging news could arrive about something that felt hopeless.
flow: A situation that hasn't been going well could show signs of improvement today. An offer of help or a long-awaited message may ease one of your worries. A major result may still take time, but there could be a reason to hope again.
Restart a postponed plan with whatever is possible now. When someone offers help, it's fine to say honestly what you need.
overall.major.star.upright.do: If you've paused something because it wasn't going well, resume the part you can do now. You don't need a major result straight away.
overall.major.star.upright.pause: Don't just say you're fine when someone offers help you need. Explain what's difficult so they can understand what to do for you.

overall.major.strength.reversed.headline: Even a small obstacle could bring things to a stop.
flow: Something you've been determined to finish may get stuck partway today. You could make a mistake in a task you usually handle well, or feel like giving up because of a remark from someone nearby. A decision made in anger is likely to leave disappointment.
It's fine to get help finishing the difficult part. A brief setback doesn't mean you need to abandon everything you've done so far.
overall.major.strength.reversed.do: If you keep getting stuck on part of a task, ask for help. Explain where you're struggling and work through that part together.
overall.major.strength.reversed.pause: Don't give up everything you're doing because someone's words made you angry. Wait until you've calmed down, then decide whether you still want to stop.

overall.major.strength.upright.headline: A difficult task could finally bring a good result.
flow: Something you've worked at for a long time could work out today. It may seem difficult at first, but continuing as you have been could get you through the hard part. Someone might also notice effort that hasn't drawn attention until now.
If a request is proving difficult, explain the circumstances calmly. The patience you've already shown is more likely to help you get a good answer than loudly demanding one.
overall.major.strength.upright.do: If something you've worked at for a long time is still difficult, keep going as you have been instead of stopping just because results aren't visible yet.
overall.major.strength.upright.pause: Don't raise your voice or pressure someone because they're slow to answer a request. Calmly explain why you need their help instead of letting urgency take over.

overall.major.sun.reversed.headline: Good things may happen on a smaller scale than you'd hoped.
flow: Even when things go well, the results may feel a little disappointing today. You could receive good news and still wish it had been better. Some things are moving slowly, so you may not get every answer today.
Don't treat a lack of news as a failure. Enjoy what you've achieved while giving the remaining results a little more time.
overall.major.sun.reversed.do: Enjoy what went well even if it fell short of your hopes. Disappointment doesn't mean you need to dismiss what your effort has achieved.
overall.major.sun.reversed.pause: Wait for results that haven't come in yet. Delayed news isn't the same as a bad result, so don't call it a failure before you know.

overall.major.sun.upright.headline: Good news could arrive as things go your way.
flow: Things could go smoothly today, with good news to match. Long-standing efforts may bring satisfaction, and something you've worried about could pass without trouble. There may even be a reason for people around you to congratulate you.
If a long-awaited opportunity comes along, take it without putting it off. Share a good result with someone who'll be pleased for you.
overall.major.sun.upright.do: If something you've worked on for a long time has gone well, tell someone close to you who will be happy to celebrate it with you.
overall.major.sun.upright.pause: Don't keep putting off a reply when an offer you've been waiting for arrives. If you'd like to accept, make that clear to the other person.

overall.major.temperance.reversed.headline: A series of small setbacks could make the day frustrating.
flow: Things may take more than one attempt to sort out today. Small setbacks could add up to delays, and a remark you'd normally overlook might lead to raised voices. Trying to make up for lost time in a hurry could disrupt what you're already doing.
With anything that's running late, finish as much as you reasonably can now. Changing all your plans or pushing other people to hurry could leave everyone more worn out.
overall.major.temperance.reversed.do: If things are running late, finish the parts you can complete now. You don't need to change the whole plan to catch up all at once.
overall.major.temperance.reversed.pause: Don't raise your voice over a small remark because things aren't going your way. Before replying, consider whether it's something you'd normally let pass.

overall.major.temperance.upright.headline: Things can go smoothly as your worries begin to ease.
flow: The day looks manageable, with things going well without much strain. A stubborn problem could gradually improve, and conversation may become easier with someone you've felt awkward around. Your good luck is more likely to mean fewer worries than a dramatic stroke of luck.
There's no need to hurry something that's already going well. Thank someone for what they've done instead of asking them to finish even faster.
overall.major.temperance.upright.do: If someone's help has made things work out, tell them what you appreciated instead of letting it pass without thanks.
overall.major.temperance.upright.pause: If a problem is gradually being resolved with someone's help, don't push them to finish even faster.

overall.major.tower.reversed.headline: A difficult situation you've feared could pass without major trouble.
flow: Something you've been dreading may turn out less dramatically than expected. Even if a problem arises, you could have a chance to stop it before it becomes hard to undo. A situation that's kept you on edge may finally offer some relief.
Acknowledging a mistake now can spare you a bigger cleanup later. Tell the people who need to know rather than covering it up because it's uncomfortable.
overall.major.tower.reversed.do: If a mistake you've made has come to light, be honest about it with the people involved. Acknowledging it now can mean less to sort out later.
overall.major.tower.reversed.pause: Don't dismiss a known problem just because a situation you feared has passed without trouble. Look into it while it can still be put right.

overall.major.tower.upright.headline: An unexpected setback could catch you off guard.
flow: Something that was going well could suddenly go wrong today. Plans you thought were definite may be cancelled, or new information could mean things won't work out as you'd hoped. An immediate response to unexpected news may leave you with regrets.
Give yourself a moment before deciding what to do when circumstances change. Hear what actually happened before demanding answers in anger.
overall.major.tower.upright.do: If unexpected news arrives, hear the full explanation of what happened before jumping to a conclusion.
overall.major.tower.upright.pause: Don't reply immediately while shocked or angry. Even if you feel like arguing, a brief pause can help you avoid words you'll regret.

overall.major.wheel_of_fortune.reversed.headline: Unexpected circumstances could cause a delay.
flow: Even careful preparation may not prevent outside circumstances from slowing things down today. An answer could be postponed, or something you thought was settled may develop a complication. You might have to wait again despite having done nothing wrong.
Don't arrange the next commitment on the assumption that this will be finished today. Respond to the latest information instead of overdoing things to make up for a delay.
overall.major.wheel_of_fortune.reversed.do: If something you're waiting for is delayed, find out what's changed and adjust any plans that depend on when it finishes.
overall.major.wheel_of_fortune.reversed.pause: Don't confirm your next commitment simply because you expect the current one to finish today. Outside circumstances could keep you waiting even if you've done nothing wrong.

overall.major.wheel_of_fortune.upright.headline: An unexpected opening could get things moving again.
flow: Luck could help things go your way today. Your turn may finally come after a long wait, or news you happen to hear could provide just the help you need. Something that hasn't worked out for a while may offer another chance.
Reply to a welcome offer before the opportunity passes. A previous failure doesn't mean you need to turn this chance down too.
overall.major.wheel_of_fortune.upright.do: If you receive a welcome offer, check when you can take part and reply before a delay costs you the opportunity.
overall.major.wheel_of_fortune.upright.pause: Don't immediately dismiss another chance at something because it didn't work out before. Hear what's changed since last time before deciding.

overall.major.world.reversed.headline: There may be one final task before you're done.
flow: Something you thought was complete could need your attention again today. The result may be fine, but a remaining check or a delayed ending could leave you feeling unsettled. Leaving that small last task undone might keep it on your mind.
Finish the remaining message or check first. Not having reached the very end doesn't make everything you've done well a failure.
overall.major.world.reversed.do: If a nearly finished task still needs a final conversation or check, complete it. Putting it off because so little remains could leave it on your mind.
overall.major.world.reversed.pause: Don't treat all your effort as a failure because the finish is delayed. Look separately at what remains and what you've already completed well.

overall.major.world.upright.headline: Something you've worked on for a long time could end well.
flow: A task could reach a satisfying finish today. A long-running problem may be nearing its end, and you could finish on good terms with the people involved. A message you've been waiting for might remove the last worry.
Take time to be pleased with what you've finished. Thank the people who helped before immediately taking on another burden.
overall.major.world.upright.do: If you've successfully finished something you worked on for a long time, tell the people involved what you appreciated about their help.
overall.major.world.upright.pause: Don't take on something new the moment you finish a long-running task. There's no need to rush past the chance to enjoy having done it well.

overall.pentacles.01.reversed.headline: Something good could have little immediate use for you.
flow: An apparently good offer may not be much help in practice today. You could receive more than you need without getting what you actually want, or a new opportunity may be difficult to use right now. Getting plenty doesn't necessarily mean you'll feel satisfied.
First consider whether it's something you need now. Instead of collecting more similar things because you've heard they're good, check how you can use what you already have.
overall.pentacles.01.reversed.do: Even if you've received plenty of new things, check whether they help with what you need to do now. Having plenty isn't the same as having what you need.
overall.pentacles.01.reversed.pause: Don't collect more items like those you already have just because you've heard they're good. There's no need to add things you haven't found a use for.

overall.pentacles.01.upright.headline: It's a good day to get what you need and start something new.
flow: An opportunity that offers practical help may come your way today. You could find an item you need or have the place and preparations ready for something you've wanted to start. Having the means to try an idea in practice could feel satisfying.
Once the opportunity is there, put whatever you can to use. Leaving it untouched while waiting for something better could mean missing the moment you need it.
overall.pentacles.01.upright.do: If you still need an item or a place for something you want to start, find out whether you can get or use it now.
overall.pentacles.01.upright.pause: Don't wait so long for better conditions that you miss your chance to use the items or space you've already secured.

overall.pentacles.02.reversed.headline: Trying to do several things at once could make you miss a commitment.
flow: Things you thought you could manage may overlap and cause trouble today. A mistake in timing could make you late, or dealing with something urgent may make you forget another task. Pretending everything is fine and carrying on with it all could leave more to sort out later.
If two arrangements clash, ask in advance to change one of them. Don't squeeze another commitment into a day that's already tight.
overall.pentacles.02.reversed.do: If appointments clash, ask which one can be changed before you're late. Explaining early is better than trying to fit them both in and falling behind.
overall.pentacles.02.reversed.pause: If you've postponed other tasks, don't book something new as soon as the urgent one is done. You could leave too little time for what's still waiting.

overall.pentacles.02.upright.headline: You could manage several things well even on a busy day.
flow: You may handle overlapping tasks successfully today. Even if something unexpected comes up, changing the timing could solve it, and keeping two things going may bring good results. Things don't have to happen exactly as planned to stay manageable.
If your priorities change, look again at the time you have left. Being honest about when you're available will make it easier for other people to adjust too.
overall.pentacles.02.upright.do: If what needs doing first has changed, look again at the time you have left and tell the person you're making plans with when you're available.
overall.pentacles.02.upright.pause: Don't say yes to two requests that need you at the same time. Be honest about which must come first and when you can actually help.

overall.pentacles.03.reversed.headline: A lack of experience could mean doing something again.
flow: You may spot shortcomings in something you thought was finished today. People could understand their parts differently, or you might miss something while trying to finish an unfamiliar task alone. Treating a small correction as an argument could delay the finish further.
Ask someone experienced to check the parts you don't know well. Pride doesn't have to stop you accepting a useful explanation.
overall.pentacles.03.reversed.do: If you've finished an unfamiliar task, ask someone who's done it before whether you've missed anything. Their explanation can help you correct what you overlooked on your own.
overall.pentacles.03.reversed.pause: Don't turn a correction into an argument by immediately making excuses. Hearing what needs fixing can reduce the chance of having to do the same work again.

overall.pentacles.03.upright.headline: Your work could earn recognition and improve with help from others.
flow: Something you've put care into may receive a good response today. Someone could recognise what you do well, while another person's help may make up for what's missing. Combining what each of you has done could bring a more satisfying finish than working alone.
If you're doing something together, start by saying what you do well. It's fine to hear the other person's explanation and leave the parts they know better to them.
overall.pentacles.03.upright.do: If you're doing something together, say which part you can do well and offer to take it on.
overall.pentacles.03.upright.pause: Don't decide the method alone for parts the other person knows better. Hearing their reasons and leaving those parts to them could make things easier than doing it all yourself.

overall.pentacles.04.reversed.headline: Opposition could delay things longer than expected.
flow: You may find it hard to go ahead with what you want today. The agreement you need could be withheld, or a longer queue may mean waiting again. Insisting on your own way may not persuade the other person to change their answer.
Find out why the answer is no first. If the conditions can change a little, ask when it might be possible again.
overall.pentacles.04.reversed.do: If something you want to do is refused or postponed, ask why first. If the conditions can change, find out when you might be able to try again.
overall.pentacles.04.reversed.pause: Don't repeat the same demand while leaving the conditions the other person finds difficult unchanged. Continued pressure may only make agreement take longer.

overall.pentacles.04.upright.headline: It's a good day to keep what you've achieved without major changes.
flow: Something familiar could continue steadily today. What you already have may be enough to deal with what's needed, without a hurried change. You're more likely to find satisfaction in what's going well now than in an uncertain offer.
Look at what you already have before deciding whether you need something new. A brief request for help doesn't have to make you fear you'll lose everything.
overall.pentacles.04.upright.do: Before getting something new, look through what you already have for anything that could serve the same purpose.
overall.pentacles.04.upright.pause: Don't refuse a request for a little help before hearing what it involves. Find out what's needed, then decide whether you can do it.

overall.pentacles.05.reversed.headline: Disagreements could leave you with more work to do.
flow: Even small things may be difficult because people can't agree today. Something you intended to solve together could turn into an argument, or doing the same thing separately may waste time. Rushing to put things right could mean redoing something already finished.
When things become tangled, finish what's under way before starting more. Taking back work you've given someone else because you're angry could only add to your own load.
overall.pentacles.05.reversed.do: If a shared task has gone wrong, check what each person has finished first so you don't repeat work that's already done.
overall.pentacles.05.reversed.pause: Don't take back work you've left to someone else just because you're angry. You'll have more to do alone, and finishing could take longer too.

overall.pentacles.05.upright.headline: A shortage of help or resources could make the day difficult.
flow: Things may feel harder to manage than usual today. Something you need could be difficult to find, or a person you expected to help may be unable to join you. Seeing others appear to do well while your own affairs are stuck could also feel upsetting.
Say specifically what you need right now. Feeling bad about accepting help doesn't mean you have to struggle alone with something essential.
overall.pentacles.05.upright.do: If what you have to do alone feels like too much, say specifically which part you'd like help with.
overall.pentacles.05.upright.pause: When asking for help, don't just keep saying that everyone else is doing well. That alone makes it hard for the other person to understand what you're missing right now.

overall.pentacles.06.reversed.headline: You may feel that what people receive isn't fairly shared.
flow: Receiving less help than you expected could leave you disappointed today. You may feel that others are getting more, or something given as a favour could come with an unexpected demand. Dwelling on comparisons may make things uncomfortable with the person who helped too.
Speak up about any conditions you find hard to accept. Disappointment in your own share doesn't mean you need to belittle what someone else received.
overall.pentacles.06.reversed.do: If someone offers help, first ask whether you'd be expected to do anything in return. If a condition is difficult to accept, say so before receiving the help.
overall.pentacles.06.reversed.pause: When talking to someone who's helped you, don't just complain that others received more. Repeating the comparison could make things uncomfortable between you.

overall.pentacles.06.upright.headline: An unexpected gift or helping hand could make the day easier.
flow: Someone may do you a favour just when you need it today. They could share something you've been looking for or help with a difficult task. If you have room to give, a small offer of help from you could be warmly received too.
Thank the person who helped you. Before helping someone else, ask what they actually need.
overall.pentacles.06.upright.do: If you received help when you needed it, thank the person and explain what became easier because of it.
overall.pentacles.06.upright.pause: Don't insist on helping without asking what the person needs first. Even with good intentions, it may not be the help they want.

overall.pentacles.07.reversed.headline: It may be hard to tell whether more effort will improve the result.
flow: Putting in more time and effort may not bring an immediate reward today. After a long wait, you could be asked to wait again, or have to decide whether to keep helping. Taking on more just because you don't want earlier effort to go to waste could prolong the burden.
Before giving more time, ask when it will be finished. If there's no clear end, it's fine to offer only what you can manage right now.
overall.pentacles.07.reversed.do: If you're asked to spend more time helping with something, first ask when it could be finished. If the end is unclear, say you'll help only as much as you can manage now.
overall.pentacles.07.reversed.pause: Don't promise to keep giving time to something with no clear end simply because you don't want the time you've already spent to go to waste.

overall.pentacles.07.upright.headline: Steady effort could show a small result.
flow: The time and work you've put in may begin to show today. Even if you aren't finished, you could see an improvement and judge whether it's worth continuing. Something you've kept working on may give you more than a hurried new start.
Take a calm look at what's done and what remains. Skipping necessary steps to see a result sooner could waste the work you've already put in.
overall.pentacles.07.upright.do: For something you've worked at steadily, look at what's improved and what remains to judge whether it's worth continuing.
overall.pentacles.07.upright.pause: When you've been working steadily on something, don't skip necessary steps to finish sooner. Complete what's left so your earlier work doesn't go to waste.

overall.pentacles.08.reversed.headline: Something you tried to finish easily could create more trouble.
flow: A shortcut you relied on could reveal a problem today. Something finished only well enough to look convincing may need redoing, and skipping a check because you're skilled could expose an omission. Clearing up afterwards may take longer than the quick finish saved.
Complete the necessary checks even on something you do well. Actually correcting a shortcoming will protect trust better than explaining it away.
overall.pentacles.08.reversed.do: Even on a task you know well, revisit any part you didn't check. If you find something missing, fix it before saying you're done.
overall.pentacles.08.reversed.pause: Don't try to gloss over flaws in what you've done with a convincing explanation. Without actually fixing them, you may have to redo the work later and lose people's trust.

overall.pentacles.08.upright.headline: Practice could give you a chance to show your skill.
flow: You could finish a familiar task skilfully today. Something that used to take a long time may become easier, and a method you've practised could prove useful. The results may not look spectacular, but your effort is likely to bring a clear return.
Keep using the method that's working and finish what's left. Rushing through something because it's boring could leave you disappointed with a small detail.
overall.pentacles.08.upright.do: If there's work left that you can do with a method you've practised, use that method to finish it.
overall.pentacles.08.upright.pause: Don't neglect small details because a task is familiar and repetitive. A careless finish can leave you disappointed even with something you do well.

overall.pentacles.09.reversed.headline: Something that looks well prepared could prove lacking.
flow: A difference between the terms you trusted and the reality could disappoint you today. A place that looked well equipped may lack something necessary, or something described as ready could fall short when it begins. An impressive-looking choice may be inconvenient in your own daily life.
Before using something or taking part, inspect whatever you can yourself. Don't confidently recommend it to others on appearances alone.
